    Thin categories with a D̃₄ core #

    A core poset has core vertices C (ordered), source leaves S below some core vertices and sink leaves T above some core vertices; all relations between leaves pass through the core (RayCat.CoreData). Its incidence category is a thin ray category (RayCat.CoreData.thin). Putting k² on the core with identity maps, a vector on each source leaf and a functional on each sink leaf gives a representation (RayCat.CoreData.rep); its natural endomorphisms are scalars as soon as the leaves cut out three distinct lines, and one leaf line ⟨(1, t)⟩ gives a one-parameter family of bricks. Category 11 of Gabriel–Roiter 10.7 (BO13a figures 6.4, 6.7, 6.10) is of this kind.

                            ¬Statement.IsRepresentationFinite (RayQuiver.Linearization (ThinCat K.thin) k)

                            Line assignments. A core poset with a connected core is representation-infinite as soon as its leaves other than one moving leaf carry the three standard lines, each at least once. This covers every orientation of D̃ₘ.
